command: set -u; echo HOST=$(hostname) USER=$(whoami); echo '---voice-dir---'; ls -la /var/lib/entityos/voice 2>/dev/null | head -80 || true; echo '---runtime-candidates---'; for f in /var/lib/entityos/voice/voice_full_runtime.py /var/lib/entityos/voice/voice_full_integration.py /var/lib/entityos/voice/realtime_gespraech.py ~/.claude/star/realtime_gespraech.py ~/.claude/star/voice_full_runtime.py; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then echo ===$f===; grep -nE 'sprecher_name|sprecher_rolle|FRANK_VOICE_DEFAULT_INSTALLATION|LOCAL_BRIDGE_OWNER|INSTALLATIONS|gespraech-erinnerung-lesen|frank_erinnerung_lesen' "$f" | head -80; fi; done; echo '---services---'; systemctl --user list-unit-files 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'frank.*voice|gespraech|titan' | head -60 || true
